name: clarvis
description: Clarvis: an unofficial Avengers fan mod for Claude Code. Live token, cost and rate-limit gauges, end-of-turn moments, a pixel arcade and comics. Free, not affiliated with Marvel or Disney.

mode.title: Look
mode.description: Which look Clarvis starts in: auto (full art, or lite text on a 256-colour terminal), full, calm (no motion), lite (text rows only) or off (stock). CLARVIS and a /clarvis <mode> choice take priority.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Show dollar amounts in the band, the end-of-turn moments and /clarvis stats.

notifyAfterMinutes.title: Notify after (minutes)
notifyAfterMinutes.description: Send a native notification when a turn that ran at least this many minutes finishes. 0 turns it off. /clarvis notify <minutes|off> takes priority.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play short original chiptune sounds (mission complete, error, trophy) in full mode. Plays on macOS only. Turn off with /clarvis sound off.
